title: FBIN Announces Agreement to Sell Fiberon
summary: Fortune Brands Innovations Announces Agreement to Sell Fiberon
body_markdown:
Fortune Brands Innovations, Inc. has announced it has executed a definitive agreement to sell its Fiberon composite decking business to a subsidiary of Inteplast Group Corporation.


The decision to sell Fiberon underscores Fortune Brands’ ongoing commitment to active portfolio management and capital allocation discipline and is intended to ensure the Company’s resources are concentrated in its highest-return opportunities.


[See Fortune Brands’ press release to learn more.](https://ir.fbin.com/news-releases/news-release-details/fortune-brands-innovations-announces-agreement-sell-fiberon)
